units.source_text: 你我宿缘之深，无以复加了。”

en.t: The bond of destiny between you and me could not be any deeper."

units.source_text: 他说时神情生动，仪态优雅，令人不胜愧感。

en.t: As he spoke, his expression was lively and his bearing elegant, making one feel deeply humbled and ashamed.

units.source_text: 玉鬘觉得他与源氏太政大臣一模一样，便放了心，吟诗作答。

en.t: Tamakazura felt that he was exactly like Genji, the Grand Minister, and so she was reassured and recited a poem in reply.

units.source_text: 她的意思是：尚未入宫建立功劳，今年已蒙加封三位，不胜感谢也。

en.t: Her meaning was that, though she had not yet entered the palace or rendered any service, she had already been granted an additional third-rank honor that year, for which she was endlessly grateful.
